name: Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP
summary: Hosted, read-only MCP server from Helena Bioinformatics for ACMG/AMP germline variant classification, gene-disease evidence and literature.
description: Connect to https://api.helena.bio/folklore/v1/mcp over Streamable HTTP; access is anonymous. 11 tools, including classify_germline_variant, resolve_gene, get_gene_profile, get_gene_disease_associations (ClinGen), search_disease_genes, search_variant_literature and search_literature_corpus. Input is one public GRCh38 nuclear germline SNV or simple indel under 50 bp (HGVS, SPDI, rsID or coordinates). Results are typed outcomes (resolved, ambiguous, not_found, unsupported...) with criteria, evidence and provenance. Meant for professional review, not diagnosis, and not for patient data. The public adapter repo is Apache-2.0. Folklore is Helena's commercial clinical genomics product; a live initialize returned server folklore 1.7.0. Submitted via listing request #11 by the operator.

agent_access.notes: Anonymous Streamable HTTP; no account or key. Read-only; don't send patient or case data.
